note: English translation only. No original japanese text. Keyed by record index and byte offset in DATA_STAGE.BIN.

rows.en:
At the Lunar Lutetium base, the combat research team
Glory Star was conducting evaluation tests on the Earth
Federation's next mass-produced unit, the Bargora． Star
３, newly assigned, felt doubts about her mission due to
Titan's slander, but was encouraged by chief Denzel and
others． An AEUG MS unit attacked the base to seize the
Bargora． Forced to sortie, Glory Star was caught in a
space distortion during battle．

When Glory Star came to, they were in an unknown colony,
Armory One． For self-defense, they fought the defense
force． Meanwhile, intruders stole a new mobile suit．
With Shinn in Impulse and Alex, Orb's representative's
bodyguard, they chased the intruders, who escaped the
colony． Minerva's captain Talia ordered the ship to
launch and told Shinn to take in the surrendered Glory
Star．

The Minerva pursued intruder Bogy One, but struggled
against Commander Neo's trap． Alex's quick thinking
saved them, but then, from a spatial distortion, AEUG
and Titans forces appeared． Amid the confused battle,
Glory Star sided with AEUG and the unknown ZAFT． The
battle ended in AEUG／ZAFT's victory, but a new
distortion swallowed Glory Star． Durandal sought
contact with AEUG to grasp the situation．

Transported to another world, Grendizer and the Vega
Fleet faced off． Glory Star joined the decisive
battle． They cornered Emperor Vega, but an unknown
alien weapon appeared, letting him escape． After
repelling the aliens, the Earth Federation surrounded
them as Unknowns． To avoid trouble, they obeyed the
military．

The group faced harsh interrogation at a Federation
base, judged as enemy PLANT agents． They told their
story to Blue Fixer's Tsukikage and Quinshtain, who
seemed sympathetic． Meanwhile, aliens appeared in
Suruga Bay． Shouhei, following his grandfather Hyoe's
orders, sortied in Zambo Ace to intercept． Duke Fried
and others joined, but the Federation sought to restrain
them． They fled to the excavated ship, Bial I．

Amid reports of Unknowns, a party hosted by the
mysterious magnate Sandman was held in Tokyo． He
announced Earth was targeted by new invaders, Zerabia．
As he said, Tokyo came under attack． Shouhei and the
others intercepted． In battle, Sandman's Earth Gult
trump card, Gravion, appeared． Sandman displayed
Gravion's power and declared his support for Duke Fried
and the group．

Fudo
「Be grateful you even get a scene.
Being forgotten entirely - now that's
real bad luck!」

Shouhei slipped out of Saint-Germain to greet his father
Gengoro returning from fishing． But in his hometown,
Katsuki and others, from misunderstanding and prejudice,
demanded the Jin family be cast out． Aliens attacked
again, but Shouhei, angered by the townsfolk's
selfishness, refused to fight． Instead, Toshiya in
Kukirai-Oh, with cousins Uchuta and Keiko, took on the
invaders． Encouraged by Gengoro, Shouhei resolved to
fight, completing Zambot ３'s combination． Victorious,
they headed to space to stop Junius Seven's fall．

The Minerva and Argama rushed to stop Junius Seven．
Amid poor coordination, the culprits were revealed as
Coordinator dissidents． To sway public opinion, Phantom
Pain let it fall, aided by the Titans, and aliens
further plunged the battlefield into chaos． King Bial
joined, and the fragmentation began． But a distortion
swallowed Glory Star． A huge shard of Junius Seven was
about to crash to Earth．

Glory Star warps to a South American elevator． Kei and
Olson repel raiders with its help． Facing new
reinforcements, Kei self-destructs it with a quake
bomb． A mystery figure shoots down Denzel． The bomb
ends the world．

Beater Service meets Garrod, flung from Ameria, at a
bazaar． Breakers raid for his Gundam； Za Heat and
Garrod repel them． Gain saves them mid-fight, then
hires them as partners．

With Gain, the group takes on the Exodus of Ulgusk．
Gainer, an ordinary boy, is arrested by Sibe Rail on
suspicion of Exodus ties． Gain infiltrates and saves
him． They seize the lord's Overman and take his
daughter Ana hostage． Repelling Sibe Rail, they begin
an unheard-of city-wide Exodus．

Gainer resented being pulled into Exodus and took it out
on his idol Sara． Gain and the others fought Sibirsk as
it pursued Yapan's ceiling． Sibirsk hired Zola's
Breakers, the Hola family, as mercenaries, and used them
as decoys while Yassaba closed in． Gainer staked his
pride, challenging Yassaba and unleashing King Gainer's
Over Skill． The Heat's Ferry brought Iron Gear as
backup, and they repelled Sibirsk． Afterward, Gainer
joined Exodus to repay Gain．

Seeking revenge on those who humiliated him, Yassaba
infiltrated Yapan's ceiling． Adette was also there to
rescue Ana, but Gain caught her． Yassaba burst in,
throwing the ceiling into chaos． Seizing the moment,
Kezinan tried to take over Sibirsk, recruiting Hola and
attacking． In the confusion, Yassaba escaped with the
fortune-teller girl Efa, vowing to stop Exodus． The
battle ended in his defeat, and bereft of all, he joined
Exodus with Efa．

Beater Service searches for Cielo Beater, lost to a
warp． A new warp brings Gekkostate and the Toshu
Federation chasing them． Za Heat offers a ceasefire,
but meddling forces a fight anyway． Another warp then
swallows Gekkostate and Iron Gear alike．

Thrown from Gallia to North America by a distortion, the
group took refuge with local boy Loran． Loran was a
Moonrace, living secretly on Earth for two years as a
sample returnee． As the Moonrace return began, a
misunderstanding led the Dianna Counter to attack．
Loran fought back in the White Doll, a mobile suit that
emerged from a statue at the coming-of-age ceremony．
Iron Gear's crew assisted, repelling the Dianna
Counter． Lord Guen, negotiating with the Moonrace,
prepared his next move．

As a bargaining chip in negotiations, Guen hired Iron
Gear's crew as bodyguards． From Enil's contact, Garrod
learned Tifa was captured by the Frost brothers and held
in this city． During the Moonrace welcome party, Garrod
rescued Tifa． Loran saved him from the Frosts． Amid
the chaos, Dianna Counter joined, aiming to weaken Earth
forces． The battle ended when Loran confessed his
Moonrace identity and Dianna appeared in his support．

In a lark, Dianna and Kihel swapped places． The group
heading to a joint exercise with the Moonrace was
shocked by the sight． Investigating, Jiron and the
others met Apollo and his friends, pursued by mysterious
girls． Then the enemy Dushantens appeared． As
Aquarion, the trump card, struggled, Apollo, enraged at
Baron's abduction, was guided into it． They won thanks
to Apollo, but Toutenshi was already planning his next
move．

Sirius and the others learn their town was warped to
another world． The Shadow Angels attack again； Iron
Gear meets them with Aquarion． Apollo beats Cherubim
troops sent by Touma, who presses him to recall a past
life． Their contact stirs a rift, and far off, a quake
bomb ends the world．

Daisuke
「To protect it, I need the help of all
of you playing this game too.」

The bomb that ended one world starts a new one． Emaan's
Factory finds Kei is a Singularity and protects him．
Chiram tries to seize him too, but Gloma repels them． A
mystery weapon appears； Kei drives it off with Phantom
Pain, then learns from Shaya a new world was born．

A series of strange murders in the memory-wiped Paradigm
City． Dorothy and the others searched for the missing
Roger, encountering incidents wherever they went．
Finally, the culprit R．D． appeared, and escaped Beck's
gang caused chaos, until Roger summoned Big O．
Schwartz, attacking in the mystic Megadeus, left cryptic
words and departed． Roger decided to leave Paradigm
City in search of truth．

Bored with his ordinary life in Bellforest, Renton met
the mysterious girl Eureka． As the new Federation and
Gekkostate clashed over her, Renton summoned his courage
for her． With Titans, ZAFT, and AEUG, the battle became
a melee, and Renton unleashed Nirvash's Seventh Swell
via the e Mitra drive from his grandfather Axel． As
Axel pressed Gekkostate to leave, Renton chose to
journey with Eureka．

At Trinity City in the Pacific, anti-alien forces
gathered around King Bial． Blue Fixer recovered a
mysterious space craft． Then the Eldars, who wiped out
Jupiter's Io colony, appeared． Burning with rage,
Toshiya, with Juli and Kiraken, completed God Sigma's
combination． With new power, King Bial departed to
fight aliens worldwide． Meanwhile, the Eldars allied
with Gaizok and Vega to destroy humanity．

$n
「Ah, at times like that, chop the
console full-force at a 45-degree
angle!!」

The Dianna Counter targeted Fort Severn, an autonomous
city in North America, as their return point from the
Moon． But this was the military's reckless act, not
Dianna's will． Calis hired Freedom to counter them．
Iron Gear's crew and the Frosts' new Federation forces
appeared, and in the melee, Dianna, disguised as Kihel,
tried to swap with Kihel disguised as Dianna． The swap
failed, but Fort Severn was defended． The defeat only
accelerated the military's recklessness．

Kejinan
「...I'm bored. Enge, switch with me.」

At a trading post, Chiram attacks Kei． The New
Federation, ZAFT, AEUG, aliens, King Beal, Shadow
Angels, Freeden, and Iron Gear all pile in, causing
chaos． Beating them back, the group meets Capt． Lowen
of Chimera． Scattered till now, the group finally
gathers as one．

Argama and Minerva, chasing Gekkostate, are forced to
fight them． Renton's cry halts it． Their will to fight
gone, all join to meet the New Federation troops that
appear． A mystery suit repels an alien - Kira's
Freedom, which once ended the last war． After, Talia
meets Holland and offers a job instead of their help．

Duke Fried visited Trinity City． Seeking his role in
the alien war, he met the S-１ alien Marin, an enemy
alien shunned by the crew． When alien attack forces
appeared, Toshiya and Duke Fried fought but struggled
against the S-１ star Aldebaron's subspace tactics．
Quinshtain asked Marin to sortie． Marin's comrades,
awakened by Duke Fried's words, defeated Aldebaron with
Baldios．s．

Talia's request for aid was denied by the independent
nation of Orb． Cagalli, its representative, was a
figurehead； real power had shifted to the Seiran
family, secretly allied with the new Federation under
the guise of protecting Orb． Leaving, they were caught
between the new Federation and Orb forces． Amuro from
Karaba and an unprecedented performance from Sin saved
them． After the battle, Sin was consumed by anger at
Orb, but kind words to soothed him． The Freedom crew
split off to watch Orb's moves．

Durandal's speech threw the world into chaos, and angry
citizens demanded the total expulsion of the Wisdom
Council． Seizing this chance, a coup broke out in the
New Earth Federation under Scirocco and Dewey． The
reformed government pinned all blame on the Council to
project a clean image, but the group grew uneasy about
the enemy lurking behind it． They defeated a New
Federation unit they encountered, but there stood the
Archangel and their former comrades．

The group opens a market． The Dianna Counter shows up
to plunder supplies． Defending themselves, they repel
Chiram too． Kei notices a familiar- moving Chiram
machine． Dianna, as Kihel, aches at the Counter's
wayward path． Chiram's plan to capture Kei advances,
led by his friend, Olson．

Awaiting them at Yapan's ceiling was their former foe
Adette． During a festival to ease tensions, Asham
appeared, seeking Gain as his sworn enemy． Gain beat
him in a duel, but Asham summoned Saint-Legan and
Sibirsk to attack in numbers． Roger, appearing as
Exodus' negotiator, saved the day． The group pressed on
toward the legendary Yapan, continuing their Exodus．

A refugee caravan was allowed aboard Yapan's ceiling．
Shouhei spotted Katsuki and his group, who blamed the
Jin family for their exile and vented their rage on
him． Ignoring a mysterious man's advice, Shouhei flew
into a rage and attacked the aliens in Zambo Ace alone．
As the Dushantens joined the chaos, he learned the value
of comrades and defeated the enemy together． Dianna,
seeing his stance, revealed her true identity to Loran．

Dome Polis Katez, the refugees' destination, is
about to be seized by the Dianna Counter． At the
lord's request, Roger goes with Guin to negotiate,
but talks break down． Asuham's scheming drags the
group into a fight with the Dianna Counter, until
Kihel, posing as Dianna, ends it with a word, and
Dianna entrusts the Dianna Counter to her． Having
beaten Asuham, the man behind it, the group bids the
refugees farewell and rejoins the Minerva and
Argama．

Gainer and the others tried to capture a Skyfish at
Holland's request． They struggled against Kashel's
Planetta, and Gain's Gatchiko was destroyed． However,
Gainer's love confession to Sara shook Kashel, and the
party won． Though Sara was angered by it, Gainer earned
Renton's respect． In the chaos, the party formed an
independent guerrilla unit to work together across
factions．

Glory Star took Asakim's bait． After repelling Chiram,
Asakim's Shrowga attacked them． They cornered Asakim
with the party, but it was his trap all along． Toby was
shot down, and Asakim left, carving an undying fear into
them． Star ３, grieving another lost comrade, decided
to live as a warrior, encouraged by those around her and
by Lowen．

Answering Asakim's call, Beater Service rushes over．
They repel Chiram, but Za Heat is wounded． Through the
pain he also beats a woman chasing Asakim． After,
Asakim leaves without saying much．

Kashel and Timp made a final gamble to stop Yapan's
ceiling． A mysterious Overman said to serve the Sibet
president Kids Munto appeared, and the battle raged．
There, Kashel's scheme revealed that Gawri killed
Gainer's parents． Gain forced Gainer to fight． The
party repelled the fallen insects with Getter Robo, and
the Exodus succeeded． But Gainer, unable to settle his
heart, decided to begin his own Exodus with his
friends．

Roger negotiates the sale of the Saotome Institute,
but Director Saotome flatly refuses, and Roger is
cursed by his mysterious client and dismissed． An
unknown enemy closes on the institute; left to hold
it while the Getter Team is away, the Elements fight
hard, but the field turns chaotic as the Hyakki
Empire, the Shadow Angels and Schwarzwald arrive．
Roger's help and the Getter Team's return win the
day, yet the Hyakki Empire in society's shadow
shakes the group． Then Boss brings word that the
Photon Power Lab has fallen．

Using the seized lab, the Hyakki Empire drives Koji's
group back． Hydler gloats； Tekkoki demands a rematch
with rival Getter Robo． Koji's group storms the lab,
and with Tetsuya retakes it． Mazinger Z and Great
Mazinger crush the Empire． They vow to wipe out the
Hyakki Empire hiding in Japan．

To catch the Hyakki Empire in one net, the group
takes the enemy's bait． Moroha of the Shadow Angels
strikes, and Aquarion, lacking teamwork, is
cornered． Moved by Tekkouki's resolve to abandon
even his homeland for pride, the group breaks both
the Empire and the Shadow Angels． Beaten by Sandman
and Fudou's plan, the Hyakki oni all take their own
lives． Japan will rejoin the New Earth Federation
under Chimera, while Holland and Jamil tell Talia
they will act apart．

The ZAFT-led group stopped in Hong Kong for supplies
from Karaba． Enjoying their free time, Shinn and Kamille
met girls named Stella and Fa． In battle with Phantom
Pain, the psycho Gundam's pilot was Fa． As Kamille held
back, Toga unhesitatingly tried to finish off the
disabled Fa． Eiji stopped him, but was angered by
Toga's cold reasoning．

With Harry of the Dianna Counter, the party attacked the
New Federation's Lohengrin Gate． Local cooperation and
Shinn's efforts won, but Shinn, lost in rage, tried to
fight beyond necessity． Against the new Zelabia, the
uncoordinated Grand Knights couldn't combine． They
barely won, but Eiji, distrusting Toga, left the ship．
Teteth, plotting to assassinate Dianna, was catching on
to her identity as Kihel．

The party sought out Eiji, but his resolve was firm. As
the alien alliance attacked, Toshiya and others sortied,
but Gaizok targeted the townsfolk. Terar, moved by
Toshiya's courage, responded in kind. Against a new
Zelabia, the reunited Grand Knights fought but were
outmatched. Sandman granted them a new power, the Super
Heavy Sword. He rejoiced in their growth, yet his past
wounds ached.

The party fought Phantom Pain． With Orb, allied to the
New Federation, joining, the Archangel and Freedom
appeared and called for a truce． Knowing it would fail,
Freedom attacked the party to stop the fighting． In the
chaos with the Ghingnham fleet, Haine fell． A
mysterious woman serving Asakim also attacked． After
the battle, the party was baffled and angered by the
Archangel and Freedom's inscrutable actions．

The party investigated a ruined lab． Human augmentation
had been studied there, and its horror shook Rey．
Phantom Pain moved to recapture or destroy the lab, the
New Federation's dark secret． In the fight, Shinn
protected Stella and Kamille persuaded Fa． But Fa
sacrificed herself to preserve her comrade Aul's
memory． The Freedom then shot down the pursuing
Athrun． With a bitter victory, the party realized the
threat of leaving the Archangel and Freedom unchecked．

Bright and the others met with Admiral Edel at the
Tampagunda base． Meanwhile, the party learned of their
detachment's selfish actions and grew angry． To
overcome her fear of Asakim, Star ３ answered his call．
Fighting Zine, Asakim's ally, she was saved by Lt．
Leben and her friends' voices． Regaining her fighting
spirit, she defeated Zine． After returning, she met
Edel and asked Dr． Jie of Kaemera to refit the
Bargoal．

Emma
「I'll go on ahead... Emma Sheen, logging
off for a rest!」

Star ３ sortied in the refitted Bargoal at Toby's call．
But waiting was Land, Asakim's ally, and they fought．
In battle, Toby appeared and shot Star ３． It was
Asakim, mutated by supernatural power． Her grief
peaked, transforming Gannery Carver into something
utterly alien． Asakim, defeated by that power, rejoiced
in her awakening． Afterward, though troubled by Land's
words about being deceived, she resolved to fight on
with the new Bargoal．

Heading to Gibraltar, the party tried to meet the
Radish, loaded with space supplies． Alert to Phantom
Pain, Kamille and others went ahead, but the enemy had
already attacked． Inexperienced Fa fought desperately
against cold Kamille． But it was Fa who saved him from
Jerid's new machine． With the Z Gundam, Kamille drove
off Jerid and the others． Afterward, Kamille found
peace in Fa's presence． Phantom Pain, having ousted
Neo, sent Commander Scirocco to the front to lead
directly．

At Gibraltar, Dianna and Durandal met, but talks
failed． Quattro then met Durandal and learned of the
multi-world crisis． That night, at Lacus Clyne's
concert, Dianna was abducted． Kamille, pursuing, faced
Paptimus Scirocco． In Phantom Pain's base attack,
Reccoa was shot down, and a coup broke out in the Dianna
Counter． Revealing herself, Dianna boarded Soleil to
save Kihel, switching places again．

Shinn and Rey's punishment for letting Stella go was
surprisingly light． Kamille chided the arrogant Shinn．
On their own judgment, the party pursued the Soleil to
save Dianna． Amid Dianna's and the New Federation's
attacks, the Freedom appeared and offered help． But
despite their efforts, Dianna was taken to space． Harry
and Kihel accepted the Archangel's offer and went to
space with them． As the party reeled, news came of the
New Federation's invasion of Chiram．D

King Vial took in the amnesiac refugees． Shouhei found
Hamamoto, Kyouko's comrade, among them． The party
intercepted the Gaizok attack． Mid-battle, the
refugees' section exploded． They had been turned into
human bombs． Shouhei burned with rage, but the enemy
was too strong． Earth's science couldn't defuse the
bombs． Hamamoto and the others left, living in fear of
detonation． Shouhei and his friends had no words to
give them．

Duke Freed heard troubling rumors at UN as he moved to
join the party． The party, burning with hatred for the
aliens, judged they couldn't win and decided to contact
the Dianna Counter to gather intel on the Moon． The
Eldar army attacked． God Sigma's new weapons won, and
they captured Terar． But Toshiya let him go to stop the
human bombs． Against the party's emotional call for
total resistance, Duke Freed left in silence．

Invited to Sandman's villa, the group hears the
truth of the Zeravire, his own secret, and his ties
to Leele． Kappei is shaken, but a mysterious man,
Banjo, encourages him back to himself． Phantom Pain
attacks under Faye, and a shock from an enemy strike
stirs fragments of Leele's memory． Afterwards
Mizuki, a New Federation spy, finishes her mission
and leaves the Gran Knights． Told the whole truth
by Touga, Leele is badly hurt by the shock． As the
Gran Knights come apart, word arrives of the New
Federation invading Chiram．

The New Federation suddenly invades Chiram, and the
overwhelming power of its new weapon destroys the
capital． The group fights to stop it, but the
Archangel and their former comrades appear as well;
they berate the group and fight the New Federation
on their own, and the field turns to chaos． Kamille
and Shinn struggle in vain: Fa and Stella lose their
lives, and Shinn burns with hatred for the Freedom
that caused Stella's death． Against the New
Federation's outrage, Durandal reveals the Council
of the Wise and declares he will bring it down．

The group faced the Archangel and their former
comrades． Talia, tasked with shooting down the
Archangel, advised surrender, but with no common ground,
battle began． Shin targeted the Freedom and fought with
all his might, finally shooting it down． This prompted
the Archangel and Iron Gear forces to retreat． Then
Banjo appeared and revealed the truth： the group and
their friends had been used by someone．

Dewey brands the Coralians mankind's enemy, winning
public support． The group repels Coralians with the New
Federation, not knowing what they are． The Coralians
hit their limit and die out． Meanwhile, Durandal meets
the "Black Charisma．"

Warned by Mizuki of the New Earth Federation's
space-time control experiment, the group sets out to
seize it． Many factions arrive, drawn by the Black
Charisma, and their former comrades appear too． In
the confusion Bloodman fires the space-time quake
bomb to break the deadlock． What should have caused
only a minute shift triggers destruction on the
scale of Break the World． Amid it, the Black
Charisma throws ominous words at the group．

Having refused ZAFT's help, the group considers what
to do next． Meanwhile the Gekkostate is in uproar
over a Coralian． Overwhelmed by the vast cloud-like
being, the group takes Holland's request and tries
to bring Eureka and Renton into contact． A black
KLF like the Nirvash appears with the New
Federation． Slipping through their attack, the
Nirvash makes contact, and the group meets something
like an illusion． A transfer throws them, and when
they come to, Tiffa has been taken．

Renton got word of Tiffa's whereabouts from Dominic, a
New Federation officer he met in town． The Zonder Epta
held an eerie legend． Garrow and Renton went ahead
alone for recon, but were caught with the Freeden by
Katock's scheme． Through Holland's desperate charge,
Jamil's resolve to save Ruchil, and Katock's
cooperation, Garrow launched the DX． They rescued Tiffa
and Eureka, but Holland made Renton realize his own
helplessness． Jamil and Holland, seeing themselves in
Katock, mourned his death．

Getter and Aquarion lost due to poor teamwork． The
Elements worked on Fudou's harsh training, but were
baffled by it． Meanwhile, Gyukenki challenged Getter．
Despite his doubts, Ryou faced him． In the ensuing
battle against the Shadow Angels, Getter and Aquarion
won with new power． Fudou left cryptic words behind．
Shaya and Mimiji then set course for Emarn．

Julie
「Toshiya...that one you and the player
find with your own wits and guts.」

Entering Emaan, the group is captured, all but Kei．
Shaya's sister Manisha will not rule out mind
control if Kei, the key to repairing space-time,
refuses． Emaan pursues them after a mysterious
woman, Ziene, helps them escape, and Gloma resolves
to leave Emaan． As ZAFT and Chiram arrive, Sley
sacrifices himself to protect Mimsy． Knowing now
they are outsiders with nowhere to belong, the group
draws closer．

To hide from various pursuers, the group fled to an LFO
excavation site in South America． As Holland grew
frustrated, Eureka complained of illness to Renton, but
he had no room to care． When enemies appeared, Eureka
went alone into the cave． Renton followed and saw her
merging with the Scab． In response to his shock and
regret, the Nirvash activated the Seventh Swell, letting
the group escape．

At Sarta base, the group met with Chimera and grew angry
at their former comrades' atrocities． They retrieved a
Vodarac monk from Chiram at Chimera's request, where
Renton again saw Holland's resolve and his own
weakness． Mail's father Cielo appeared, but it was a
trap set by Asakim to damage Beatrice Service． With
Lowen and Setsuko's help they repelled the enemy, but
Mail, learning of her father's disappearance and her
body's secret, rejected the Heat．

Holland and the others met General Edel and were
impressed by his noble character． Meanwhile, the Heat,
with Dr． Jie's help, unsealed Ganleon． The Heat
pursued Asakim on Setsuko's intel, but without Ganleon,
they were powerless． After Beatrice Service regained
their bond with allies' support, they unleashed
Ganleon's sleeping power and defeated Asakim． As the
group celebrated with General Edel, Renton left the ship
out of self-loathing．

Fed up with Holland, Garrod's group searches for
Renton． In the city, Renton befriends mercenaries the
Beams． The group joins Pala against thugs； Ennil grows
honest and helps too． Renton leaves with the Beams．
Garrod's group waits for his return．

The group enjoyed freedom until Renton returned． Roger
appeared and gave Kei a message from a mysterious
figure． It was his old friend Olson, now a Chiram
soldier, requesting cooperation． But Robert, eager for
glory, tried to force-capture Kei． Olson helped them
escape, but vengeful Asham and his men appeared． They
repelled them, but Guroma reported the main force's dire
straits, forcing their return． Olson, having disobeyed
orders, was summoned home, and pondered who was right,
himself or Kei．

Kappei
「Hey hey, Uchuta and Keiko too! ...What
are you doing?」

Gekkostate separated from the main force to settle
things with their old acquaintance Charles． Meanwhile,
Renton was offered adoption by the Beams, but chose
Eureka and left them． Charles and Holland clashed．
Eureka and Renton reunited, and the others who defeated
the Over Devil joined up． Despite Renton's cries, the

mankind should advance into space, and led the
Spacenoids． He made Side 3 independent as the
Republic of Zeon, and was the father of Char
Aznable, known as Quattro Bajeena． Foreseeing the
birth of Newtypes, he negotiated patiently with
the Earth Federation to protect Earth and realise
that evolution． But those around him lost
patience with the Federation's high-handed manner
and wanted the Spacenoids' hopes made known by
force． Zeon then died suddenly, and his hardline
aide Degwin Sodo Zabi succeeded him, turning the
Republic into the Principality, declaring war, and
filling the army's key posts with his family．

the Zabis．
